{{Top|leg}}
'''Lab Module C''' was one of the [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] modules of the [[Maw Installation]]. It housed various working spaces where projects were gestated until they needed full facilities of their own. The initial work on the [[World Devastator]] project was carried out in Lab Module C.
